findings: Neither sequence contains blank or visibly corrupt frames.
The visible source beaker translates, lifts, tilts, and settles instead of remaining at its initial pose.
Both lanes use the same fixed trajectory-envelope camera and remain visually comparable.
During source motion the beaker alternates between clear, pale, and ghosted appearances in adjacent RTX frames.
The same defect is present in raw CUDA frames and H.264-decoded frames, so encoding and the web player are not the root cause.
DLSS, native AA, one discarded transition frame, and native AA plus one discarded transition frame all failed the flicker gate.
Detached liquid remains visible and numeric pre-tilt retention fails.
The videos are retained only as failure evidence and are not promoted as current diagnostic delivery.
